objective: Remediate system logging gaps across firmware, backend MQTT handlers, database schemas, watchdog, and frontend (Proposals C1–C20).

acceptance.criterion: ESP32 firmware emits PublishFsmTransition on all fault/lockout transitions and provides TransitionReason::HardTimeout
ESP32 sensor node connects to MQTT with Last Will and Testament (LWT) configured on TOPIC_STATUS
Watchdog monitors sensor node topic staleness in addition to controller status topic
Backend persists operational FSM transitions, OTA lifecycle updates, and user config updates to system_events
Database schema migration enriches dosing_action_log and flow_execution_log, and retention cleanup prunes logs older than 90 days
Shared types provide dedicated DosingEvent and SensorEvent metadata variants, and diagnostic worker triggers on sensor staleness and dosing anomalies
acceptance.verification: cargo test --manifest-path hydragrow-shared/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path hydragrow-diagnostic-worker/Cargo.toml

acceptance.criterion: Frontend SystemLog provides filter awareness and dedicated guidance for sensor logs
acceptance.verification: cd hydragrow-frontend && npx vitest run src/pages/SystemLog.test.tsx
